## Inspect

![Inspect icon](../../assets/icons/InspectComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Inspect` · GUID `1d56a553-7a66-451f-90e2-81e744b43bdd` · exposure primary

Text report and provenance of a plan, floor, or building.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Object | `O` | Generic Data | item | no | – | A plan, floor, or building. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Report | `R` | Text | item | Zones, loads, and surfaces. |
| Provenance | `P` | Text | item | How the object was produced, with code version. |

## Map Source to Target

![Map Source to Target icon](../../assets/icons/MapSourceToTargetComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Map` · GUID `eee37e01-28a2-4b5a-9c7d-7566cb9d93d4` · exposure primary

The source-to-target overlap rows of a floor (spec §11).

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Floor | `Floor` | [Floor](info.md#floor) | item | no | – | A simplified floor. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Source | `S` | Text | list | Source zone of each row. |
| Target | `T` | Text | list | Target zone of each row. |
| Overlap | `A` | Number | list | Overlap area, m². |
| Source Fraction | `SF` | Number | list | Overlap / source area. |
| Target Fraction | `TF` | Number | list | Overlap / target area. |

## Validate

![Validate icon](../../assets/icons/ValidateComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Validate` · GUID `03558c0b-83e8-417d-b122-96ebde64c147` · exposure primary

Checks a floor or building against its prescribed conservation invariants.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Object | `O` | Generic Data | item | no | – | A floor or building. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Passed | `P` | Boolean | item | Whether every enforced check passed. |
| Report | `R` | Text | item | One line per check. |
